description: Export a Google Slides presentation to pdf or pptx into blob storage and return its deck_blob_key. Runs as a background job: a missing id or unsupported format is refused at once; otherwise dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the deck_blob_key (with namespace, filename and the account used) arrives via a follow-up message once the export completes (read it any time with service_interface::job_service::get_job). Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Export a Google Slides presentation's rendered bytes as pdf or pptx into platform blob storage, delivering a blob key on completion rather than the bytes themselves. Google-native presentations need this export path to leave Drive as a file, and the result can then be emailed or handed to another plugin.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the export (job_id, status queued); the finished job's result is deck_blob_key (a blob-storage reference to the exported bytes), namespace, filename and account. Completion is delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Say the export is running. Once it completes: confirm the export and format used. The deck_blob_key references potentially sensitive content — surface it for downstream use but do not treat it as public.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Export a Google Slides presentation into blob storage.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: At dispatch: gsuite.invalid_params: missing id or format is not pdf/pptx. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.unknown_account: `account` names no connected account. In the finished job: gsuite.not_found: the id does not exist; gsuite.permission_denied, gsuite.rate_limited or gsuite.auth_expired: Google refused the export. gsuite.invalid_params at dispatch can also mean the session_id/flow_id context is missing. gsuite.api_error at dispatch means the job could not be queued (AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: pass format as pdf or pptx. gsuite.not_found: the presentation may have been deleted. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error at dispatch: retry once platform startup has completed.
